mechanism: Replace a diagonal source approximation, not an incoming K22 plane or a terminal mean.
law_decomposition: dgn = dgn_iso + gamma*gbar*(diagB - aB*v), with original scaling implicit in the table. D subtracts existing carried/birth/row diagonals; all those subtractions stay unchanged.
residual: delta_raw = rowsum(post22) - dgn_iso. On represented birth hubs, delta = delta_raw - radial_template*sum(delta_raw)/sum(radial_template). Unrepresented units are zero.
radial_template: tr(C_post)*diag(C_post) + 2*rowsum(C_post*C_post), captured alongside post22 before learned corrections; original radial scalar untouched. Degenerate template falls back to a constant on the same eligible roster.
pair_identity: With p+ - p- = gap*e_h and lam+ = birth/gap*s_new = -lam-, adding q=[z,-z], x=[-z,z] gives 2*kap_next*NP_DIAG*delta_h*e_h*e_h^T; z=2*kap_next*NP_DIAG*delta_h/(s_new*gap*birth).
retained: Explicit anisotropic carry, old diagonal subtractions, source strength NP_DIAG, row/birth source coefficients, all K22 and marginal formulas, scalar radial update, and all existing head inputs.
limitations: post22 and dgn_iso use different approximate cumulants and mean centering. Newborn hub restriction omits always-on units. Radial cancellation is exact at the represented post-source level up to floating point; later physical transport can change its trace. No gain or true-moment accuracy claim.
